text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PROD-NEWROLL-503 (P1) — multiple 5xx across eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Auto-escalate in 5m if unacked. link: https://pd.example/alerts/PROD-NEWROLL-503 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Alert details: 12 services impacted, high error rate on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Symptoms: 502/503 from mlproxy and embedder timeouts. Runbook: check canary rollout, traffic split, and kernel flags.

meera: Acked. I'm current oncall, taking this. Canary rollout v3.4.1 started ~2:15 UTC, matched rollout policy to 10% in eu-west and 5% in us-west. I'm pulling canary metrics now.

james: Seeing a lot of 502s with this stack: ``Error: upstream read ECONNRESET\n at mlproxy/handler.js:142`` — looks like kv-cache misses + new quant kernel path. Pushing logs to the bridge.

sara: prod-support here. Customers are reporting 500s for inference requests. Any pattern by endpoint or tenant?

meera: Mostly /v1/generate and some rerank endpoints. Affected tenants concentrated in EU. Rough impact ~2-4% global request failure but spikes to 8% in eu-west canary pool.

james: Log snippet from mlproxy (tail):
```
[2026-03-15T02:32:47Z] mlproxy: request id=abc123 route=/v1/generate status=502 backend=embedder err="kvcache-miss + timeout on quant-kernel"
[2026-03-15T02:32:47Z] embedder: shard=12 latency=1200ms qpath=new-quant err=timeout
```

release-engineer: We just rolled the quantized kernels in this release. If canary shows regression we should abort and roll back to previous image. Command to abort: ``./release-orch rollback --service model-serving --rev previous`` — will start rollback now unless you want to try disabling kernel flag.

meera: I'm going to abort canary and divert traffic back to v3.3.8. Starting rollback via release-orch now. Notifying CDN and edge. /cc ops_lead

ops_lead: Opening incident bridge and paging SRE for follow-up: https://zoom.inc/bridges/5167894321 — posting to oncall channel. Also pinging CS.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert escalated (unack after 4m) — paging oncall lead.

oncall-rot13: Ack. I'm joining bridge and taking lead. Meera, handover please.

meera: Handover: canary at 10% eu-west, 5% us-west. Symptom: increased p99 and 5xx after quant kernel load; KV cache miss rate up ~4x. Rollback command issued at 02:36 UTC. Keeping logs and core dumps in /var/incidents/5167894321.

james: If needed I can push a quick hotfix to disable the new kernel path: ``./deploy --service model-serving --env prod --set disable_quant=true`` — that'll avoid full rollback if you'd rather toggle.

prod-support: Customer impact summary: 23 tenants across EU reporting errors (mostly retries surface). Top 5 customers: tenant-42, tenant-88, tenant-103, tenant-211, tenant-7. CS escalation opened; recommending proactive emails if rollback not completed in 10m.

ops_lead: Decision: perform immediate canary rollback + region diversion. No incremental mitigation seems safe right now. Proceeding with rollback path.

release-engineer: Rollback started: eu-west canary reversed to v3.3.8 at 02:37:12 UTC. Traffic diversion policies updated.

meera: Post-rollback metrics: eu-west canary 503 rate down from 7.8% -> 0.9% within 2m. p95 latency returning to baseline. Leaving traffic diverted for 30m while we monitor.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert suppressed by auto-suppression after rollback.

sara: I'll draft a short customer advisory and incident summary. Can someone drop a quick timeline and links to logs / bridge in the incident doc?

meera: Timeline: 02:15 UTC rollout started (v3.4.1), 02:29 UTC first 5xx spike observed, 02:32 UTC PagerDuty fired, 02:36 UTC rollback command issued, 02:39 UTC canary rollback confirmed, 02:41 UTC error rate stabilized. Bridge link + logs: https://infra.logs/5167894321 + https://zoom.inc/bridges/5167894321

oncall-rot13: Handing to eng-oncall for monitoring and RCA. I'll stay muted on bridge for 30m in case of re-escalation. Signing off from active lead. :thumbsup:

release-engineer: Follow-up tasks: capture heap profiles, compare kernel perf vs. baseline, test quant path in staging with longer cache warmup, and create a changelist to gate quant kernel behind a runtime flag.

meera: I'll create the postmortem doc and assign owners. Thanks everyone for quick responses.

prod-support: Noting impacted customers list for CS. Will wait for the advisory draft.

james: Will open a PR to add the runtime flag + add canary watch alerts for kvcache miss spikes.

incident-bot: Thread closed by incident-bot after suppression and rollback.
